description: Tasmanian Load Limited Bridges and Roads is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of State Growth (Tasmania). There are roads and bridges on the Tasmanian road network which have a load limit applied by the Road Manager. This can be for many reasons; the road pavement has been damaged, or stress has occurred on a bridge which requires a limit to be placed on it. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of State Growth (Tasmania). Its tags are EARTH SCIENCE - HUMAN DIMENSIONS - INFRASTRUCTURE - TRANSPORTATION, Tasmania, Transport, Transportation. It offers 1 resource(s) in ARCGIS REST  WMS  WFS. The portal shows 2023-08-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
